concerns.text: Spec FR-003 mandates a χ² goodness-of-fit test with Monte Carlo/exact p-value estimation and an automatic exact/Monte Carlo fallback when any expected bin count < 5. The tasks implement only the Block Bootstrap deviation test and explicitly state 'no circular uniform Monte Carlo'. The FR-003 fallback path (exact multinomial fallback is mentioned only for bin counts, not the χ²-with-Monte-Carlo primary test) and FR-004's 'p-value (computed via Monte Carlo or exact method)' are silently replaced by a different methodology. Either the spec must be revised to authorize the deviation-test design, or tasks must implement the mandated test — as written, tasks tagged [FR-003]/[FR-004] fall short of those FRs.

T103 requires 'the α=0.05 and Bonferroni flags present' in data/processed/stats_{p}_5000000.json, but the schema has additionalProperties: false and defines no fields for either flag. The task's verification as written cannot pass against the contract it also requires conformance to — the schema must be extended or the flags moved to a separate artifact.

SC-002 requires p-value validity measured against synthetic uniform/biased datasets. The plan forbids synthetic uniform simulation as 'circular', and no task in tasks.md executes any synthetic-dataset validation. The coverage claim 'SC-002: verified T015/T016' is unsupported — the acceptance criterion is dropped, not preserved.

These batches are described as 'Preserved as verified' yet are unchecked (- [ ]), and T014 appears both in the checked T005/T004/T007/T008/T009/T014 line and in the unchecked T010–T014 batch. The completion status is internally contradictory; if the work is genuinely verified it should be checked, otherwise the 'preserved as verified' claim is a retroactive assertion of work with no verifiable artifact in this document.

concerns.location: tasks.md:all tasks vs constitution.md:Principles III & V
concerns.text: The constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed and recorded in the state YAML artifact_hashes map, and the plan's constitution check claims 'checksums recorded in state YAML'. No task (T100–T106) performs checksumming or state-file updates for the generated data/raw/ and data/processed/ files. This is a constitution violation introduced by omission — add a checksum/state-update step to T102 or a dedicated task.

FR-007 specifies graceful failure at ≥ 90% of the memory limit; tasks carry only 'MemoryGuard polling every 10000 iterations with graceful MemoryLimitExceeded failure' without the 90% threshold, and T100's --memory-limit-mb default of 7000 vs the 7 GB (7168 MB) runner limit leaves the effective threshold ambiguous. Carry the concrete 90% figure through.

Verification 'python -c "import code.run_analysis"' imports a package named 'code', which shadows the stdlib 'code' module and can spuriously fail depending on sys.path; use a runpy/-m invocation so the verification step doesn't fail for reasons unrelated to the deliverable.
